purpose: L1 continuation: independently observe eye aperture in first source event; bracket visible closure/reopening, not recover Cubism parameters or exact authored onset.
hypothesis: Existing paired near-zero iris visibility corresponds to bilateral lid closure rather than a one-eye wink.
role: development observation; previously measured iris curves selected the event. No heldout or full-cycle claim.
render: Decode original MP4 sequentially at original resolution; map frozen crop by actual original/reference dimensions; scale each to240x120px; four256x144 tiles per row; no image changes beyond documented crop/resize/labels.
measurementBeforeView: Source hashes, original decoded frame and crop hashes, sheet hashes/dimensions; original R3 iris area/height copied only for context. No thresholds refit.
reviewRules: At most two new sheets, each dimension<=1024; all source crops use selected unreviewed indices, no old sheets reopened.
For each sampled frame, record left/right aperture visible, shut, or uncertain; interval bounds follow adjacent observed states.
Onset and fully-open restoration remain null if relaxed reference aperture is not independently established.
An ambiguous lid silhouette is not full closure; uncertain cases retained.
A wink claim needs one visibly closed eye while the other has a clearly open aperture in the SAME frame.
No native shader, art asset, motion timing, rig, Soot or deployment changes.
